months.label: Applicable months
months.help: Only seasonal themes need months; tap to toggle, and a range may wrap the year (November to January, say).

themes.title: Theme taxonomy
themes.description: Maintain seasonal themes and shop types: five-language names, applicable months, order and status. Names appear as-is in the hotspot theme filters, without going through the message catalogs.
themes.slugHelp: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens; fixed once created.
themes.monthsRequired: A seasonal theme needs at least one month

intros.title: Introductions
intros.description: AI-drafted, admin-reviewed introductions. Readers only see approved text, one paragraph per attraction per language.

editor.title: Themes for {name}
editor.description: Tick the themes that apply; a seasonal theme can carry months just for this attraction.
editor.shopOnly: Shop types only apply to attractions in the Shopping category.
editor.noThemes: No active themes yet; add one under Themes first.
editor.removed: Removed (the seed file will not add it back)
